items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Because my first teacher, a classical teacher, told me that the first lesson.

ctx.x: While you’re playing you’re learning how to play technically the instrument, you develop your ear as to become a bassist. So this is not a book to become a super soloist, it’s a book about to be a bassist. Because my first teacher, a classical teacher, told me that the first lesson. He didn’t know anything about jazz. It was just classical.
